summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of setting a header to None in a session, but it may introduce unintended side effects.

issues.description: Setting a header to None in a session should be allowed, but the patch removes the header entirely instead of treating None as an empty string. This could break existing code that relies on headers being set to None.
There are no tests provided to verify the behavior of setting a header to None in a session. This increases the risk of regressions in the future.
